newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT revises down 97/98 capex plan to 1.89 trln yen.
newsitem.headline: NTT revises down 97/98 capex plan to 1.89 trln yen.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp said on Friday it expects to spend 1.89 trillion yen on capital investment in the year to end-March 1998, downwardly revising its original planned spending of 1.94 trillion yen.
The revision follows the separation of its software development group on April 1 and the establishment of a new unit.

NTT also upwardly revised its parent current profit forecast for the 1997/98 business year, reflecting the fact that part of its costs for software development will be spread out over the next five years as a result of the spin-off of the software group.
The new unit, NTT Communicationware Corp, is staffed by 9,500 workers.
